title: Circuit satisfiability reduces to three-CNF satisfiability
statement: Let binary encodings be given for Boolean circuits and three-CNF formulas, and suppose there is a certified polynomial-time map on binary strings that sends every canonical circuit encoding to the canonical encoding of its associated three-CNF formula and sends every malformed circuit encoding to a malformed formula encoding. Then the language of encodings of satisfiable circuits is Karp reducible to the language of encodings of satisfiable three-CNF formulas.
